purpose: Promote only the public taroz precomputed result MAT coordinates through a deterministic local converter; do not rerun MATLAB or alter production RTK/SPP defaults.

archive.license_caveat: The public archive has no separate license file; it remains a local cache and is not vendored or redistributed.

mat_inventory.hash_semantics: CRC32 and SHA256 were computed from ZIP decompressed streams; the stream bytes are identical to an extracted member.

upstream_semantics.run_fgo: Final result_gnss_imu.mat is loaded for submission; result_gnss.mat is the GNSS-only comparison.
upstream_semantics.write_results: MAT results are written after optimization; saved gt.Gpos already includes add_position_offset.
upstream_semantics.add_position_offset: Phone-specific body offset is rotated and applied before saving gt.Gpos; converter does not apply it twice.
upstream_semantics.submission: Official sample supplies tripId/UnixTimeMillis row order; upstream intersects obs.utcms and fills missing positions.
upstream_semantics.score: Upstream score is Haversine with gt.C.RE_WGS84 and mean of P50/P95; this lane reports the repository's four explicit diagnostics separately.

runtime.mat_format: MATLAB v5 MCOS FileWrapper__ workspace; little-endian IM marker

decode_contract.object: Only gt.Gpos.llh and gt.Gpos.n are decoded; opaque object class must be gt.Gpos.
decode_contract.workspace: Segment tables, one-based string/property indices, object-table ordinal and heap cells are bounds-checked.
decode_contract.coordinates: LLH latitude/longitude/height are used exactly as stored; no sample coordinate, truth, v5, nearest remap, or estimator rerun is used.
decode_contract.time: Preferred source is GobsPhone.obs.utcms UTC milliseconds from phone_data.mat, matching upstream submission.m; direct conversion accepts unique monotonic device_gnss.utcTimeMillis only as an explicit fallback.
decode_contract.finite: Finite LLH rows only; non-finite rows are omissions and are never silently converted to zeros.
decode_contract.interpolation: Same-trip latitude/longitude/height linear interpolation only for a bracket gap <=10000 ms.
decode_contract.edge_hold: Same-trip finite constant endpoint hold only for a one-sided gap <=1000 ms; no extrapolation beyond this bound.
decode_contract.continuity: Published rows must have finite WGS84 ECEF transitions at <=70 m/s; otherwise fail closed.
decode_contract.dummy_guard: Known sample sentinel (34.640195,-120.589642) is never emitted; sample coordinates are not read as a fallback.

development_cohort.selection: Existing train-role identities from the prior metadata-only split inventory; route-disjoint validation and future holdout remain sealed.
development_cohort.comparison_result: result_gnss.mat (reported comparison only; no truth-based parameter selection)
development_cohort.truth_read_authorization: After this freeze, matching train ground_truth.csv may be read once for four-diagnostic reporting; validation/holdout/test truth remain unopened.

sample_key_authority.use: keys and order only; official sample coordinates are never a prediction fallback

pre_truth_checks.all_result_structural_decode: 77/80 strict finite; 3/80 contain published NaN rows and are reserved for bounded omission/fail-closed reporting
